title: Markdown and HTML in a link label
note: Revisions two to seven of 0.4 are not snapshotted; the label bake (data-blyg-label, #81), links[] (#79), CommonMark blockquote extent (#76) and LF/CRLF line endings (#76) come from them, so those cases cite the living text.

items.content_md: Small tools, used daily, beat big tools used rarely.
items.content_html: Small tools, used daily, beat big tools used rarely.

ambiguous: §10.1 says the label is 'everything after that pipe up to ]]' and is the anchor text, and §10.2 bakes a directive's label 'verbatim and HTML-escaped'. It does not say whether markdown or HTML inside a link label is rendered. The expectation takes the label as literal text (the author's words, escaped), which matches the directive rule.
